name: @qoniai/qoni
description: Unified Node.js SDK for Qoni Agent delegation, GenAuth management, GUMem memory, and WebAgent automation.

scripts.test: pnpm build && pnpm check:brand && pnpm test:mock && pnpm test:package
scripts.test:mock: vitest run --coverage=false tests/qoni.test.ts tests/semantic-surface.test.ts tests/open-source-readiness.test.ts tests/complete-coverage.test.ts tests/event-catalog.test.ts tests/interactions.test.ts tests/contract-surface.test.ts tests/sse-abort.test.ts tests/do-anything-evidence.test.ts tests/query-matrix.test.ts tests/live-evidence.test.ts tests/site-login-settle-track.test.ts tests/abstract-interactions.test.ts tests/genauth-management.test.ts tests/genauth-communication.test.ts tests/genauth-hosted-login.test.ts tests/personal-agent-page.test.ts tests/agent-provisioning.test.ts tests/formal-agent-silent.test.ts tests/formal-agent-wildcard.test.ts tests/delegation-normalizer-r3.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:matrix: QONI_LIVE_E2E=1 QONI_QUERY_MATRIX=1 QONI_LIVE_ALLOW_ENV_CONSTRAINTS=0 vitest run --coverage=false --fileParallelism=false --maxWorkers=1 tests/live-e2e/query-matrix.test.ts
scripts.test:e2e:release: QONI_LIVE_E2E=1 QONI_LIVE_REQUIRE_ALL=1 QONI_LIVE_ALLOW_ENV_CONSTRAINTS=0 vitest run --coverage=false --fileParallelism=false --maxWorkers=1 --testTimeout=120000 tests/live-e2e/*.test.ts
